node.title: Exact extension-code/interleaving list identity
node.statement: For every finite extension E/B of degree m and base-field domain D, coordinate expansion is a Hamming isometry mapping RS[E,D,k] bijectively to RS[B,D,k]^{==m}; all received-word and worst-case list sizes agree exactly. The prize denominator remains |B|. [IMPORT REPAIR #88 (2026-07-12): this re-proves survey Lemma 2.21 = [BCFW25, Lemma D.3] — citation added; the proof was independently verified pointwise (F_4/F_2 exhaustive) so the uncited re-derivation is sound, just unattributed.]
